objects.name: The Pilgrims' First Light
objects.vInscr: The pilgrims lit this one first, and spoke the road's first word here: down.

objects.name: Chalked Waystone
objects.vInscr: Kindled by pilgrims. Touch it, and every lit waystone on the Hide knows your step.

landmarks.name: The Unshod Waymark
landmarks.inscription: Past this stone the road was held too holy for shoes. The shoes are waiting still.

landmarks.name: The Sword None Drew
landmarks.inscription: No hand great enough to draw it has come back for it. Many lesser hands have tried.

landmarks.name: The Unmirroring Ring
landmarks.inscription: Seven stones for Ysse, who could not bear her own face. The water keeps her wish: lean over it, and it shows you only the dark.

landmarks.name: The Bound Oathwright
landmarks.inscription: They tied their god to the tree so it could not leave them. It did not leave. It did not answer either.
